verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Typesense is optimized for instant search-as-you-type over indexed documents. That is an adjacent capability, not query suggestions drawn from real search traffic or from a dedicated suggestions index. Nothing in the pack mentions query analytics, popular-query aggregation, or a suggestions collection, so this is a none verdict rather than partial credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve query suggestions and autocomplete backed by real search traffic or a suggestions index
